bBLv6JDgdpo.title: Noah: The Work of Faith
bBLv6JDgdpo.summary: From Hebrews 11:1-7 and Genesis 6, a look at Noah, who believed God's warning of a flood no one had ever seen and built the ark. Real faith shows in what we do: don't just walk with God, work for God.

wDxOt9zxxdg.title: A Jet Tour of Isaiah, Part 1
wDxOt9zxxdg.summary: The first of three messages surveying Isaiah: the prophet, the kings of Judah he served, and chapters 1-22 traced to their New Testament quotations, showing his prophecies about Israel will be literally fulfilled.
